'''Bhansgrek''' was a gentle shrub that bloomed once every hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. A bhansgrek was kept onboard the [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|Naboo Cruiser]] in a special field that prolonged its time of blooming. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], a grove of these was planted within the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]] at the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
